Requirement Text: The system SHALL detect obstacles within a 50-meter radius using LiDAR
The system SHALL classify obstacles as static or dynamic with 95% accuracy
The system SHALL process camera images at minimum 30 FPS
The system SHALL fuse sensor data into unified world model
The system SHALL compute collision-free trajectories within 200ms
The system SHALL maintain position accuracy within ±0.5m
The system SHALL estimate 6-DOF pose at 100 Hz
The system SHALL execute autonomous takeoff to 5m altitude
The system SHALL execute autonomous landing with ±0.5m accuracy
The system SHALL provide real-time telemetry at minimum 1 Hz
The system SHALL maintain end-to-end latency < 100ms
The system SHALL achieve obstacle detection accuracy > 99.5%
The system SHALL prevent flight outside authorized airspace
The system SHALL execute emergency landing on critical failure
The system SHALL maintain detection if single sensor fails
